info.description: The Food Delivery Refunds API provides a comprehensive solution for listing and managing refunds related to food delivery services. This endpoint allows businesses to retrieve detailed information about refund transactions for deliveries. Typical consumers include logistics operators and financial teams seeking to reconcile accounts or improve customer service. By integrating this API, businesses can effectively track and manage refund requests to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details about refunds associated with deliveries. Use this to check the status of a refund or obtain further information about the refunded transactions.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a refund process for deliveries. This includes necessary information required to process the refund.

201.description: Refund request processed successfully and is now reflected in the system.
